protocol.replicates: summarize.py aps_boot() prep/wap/interval copied verbatim; M3 added inside the same replicate loop without consuming extra RNG
protocol.rng_reset: np.random.default_rng(20261101) reset once per dataset (val, test) exactly as in aps_boot
protocol.val_sampling: unique original validation IDs (np.unique of the five val_rows) stratified by label; one shared weight vector per replicate, sliced by np.searchsorted(union, val_rows) mapping; weights shared across the five splits
protocol.test_sampling: np.arange(len(y_test)) as IDs; the same official test row weights are shared across all five fitted models and all stress inputs
protocol.per_replicate_draw: ix = r_[rng.choice(pos, len(pos), replace=True), rng.choice(neg, len(neg), replace=True)]; weights = np.bincount(ix, minlength=len(union)).astype(float)
protocol.estimator: per split, per stress family: mean over the 3 family replicas of AP(A) - AP(B) (unweighted sklearn AP point estimate; weighted-AP difference inside the bootstrap); family estimate = mean over the five splits; ci95 = np.quantile(draw_mean_over_splits, [.025, .975])
protocol.point_estimand_note: point estimate uses sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score on raw scores for each replica, then averages the per-replica differences (identical to summarize.py); the bootstrap uses the same weighted-AP wap() on the resampled weights
protocol.sign_convention: delta = AP(first) - AP(second); negative delta means C025/B025 is WORSE than the comparator
